input.command: git diff --cached --stat && git diff --stat && diff_file=$(mktemp /tmp/kk-review-code-XXXXXXXX.patch) && git diff --cached > "$diff_file" && wc -l "$diff_file" && echo $diff_file && ls docs/feat/wip/ 2>/dev/null; ls
